name: Town East Gate
arrivalText: The massive reinforced ironwood gates of Oakhaven's eastern wall loom before you, guarded by armored sentries watching the road to the dark birch woods.
description: The fortified gate guarding Oakhaven's eastern exit, leading toward the foothills and birch thickets. Sentries stand watch day and night to keep wild beasts and goblins at bay.
visualTheme: A stone fortification gate with heavy double doors, iron bands, guard towers, and clean flags waving in the wind.

history.createdWhy: Built during the Second Orc War to secure the hamlet's eastern approaches.
history.builtWho: Eldorian Royal Engineers and local craftsmen.
history.majorEvents: Successfully repelled a massive goblin raid five years ago.
history.whyExists: Acts as the checkpoint and defense line for traders heading east.
history.currentConflicts: Increased goblin scout activity has put the guards on high alert.

npcs.name: Captain Vaelen
dialogue: Move along, traveler. Keep your weapon handy once you leave the walls.
The Eastern forests grow more dangerous by the day.
State your business. We don't need any more trouble makers here.
